meta.title: Blacklist Re-Onboarding Prevention: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Sign in as a Compliance Officer on the Growth and Enterprise tenants and compare the Blacklist Re-Onboarding Prevention capability.
Change or select tenants by subscription plan when their IDs are not provided.
Use Blacklist Re-Onboarding Prevention to block blacklisted entities from re-onboarding via shared identifiers.
Observe the capability being absent or refused on Growth and available and working on Enterprise.
